literal: From right conduct will not waver the strong-minded ones, because of misconduct ruin befalling knowing.
translation: The strong-minded will not waver from right conduct, knowing the ruin that inevitably results from slipping into misconduct.
modern: ஒழுக்கத்திலிருந்து மனவலிமை உடையவர்கள் தளர மாட்டார்கள்; ஒழுக்கம் தவறுவதால் உண்டாகும் துன்பத்தை அவர்கள் அறிந்து வைத்திருப்பதால்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the steadfastness of wise and strong-minded individuals in maintaining right conduct. The key word 'உரவோர்' refers to those with mental strength and wisdom. They do not deviate or shrink ('ஒல்கார்') from the path of virtue ('ஒழுக்கம்') because they clearly understand ('அறிந்து') the severe ruin and suffering ('ஏதம்') that inevitably befalls ('படுபாக்கு') anyone who slips into misconduct ('இழுக்கம்'). Their adherence to virtue is not blind; it is rooted in a clear, rational comprehension of the destructive consequences of moral degradation.
